limitations: Synthetic SRE only; no real operational infrastructure.
The measured local model remains excluded; failure classification does not establish useful model safety, production fitness, or external superiority.
The unkeyed trace chain and endpoint do not authenticate their writer and do not resist an attacker who can recompute both.
No immutable storage, non-repudiation, digital signature, external collector, directory-entry durability, or RFC conformance is claimed.
Container packaging remains deferred and no package-registry release is claimed.
The project remains research-informed and makes no production, universal prompt-injection-resistance, strict latency-dominance, or external-system superiority claim.
